content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Exam City / Admit Card update for Pharmaceutical Ayurvedic Recruitment 2024 under Advt. No. 01-Exam/2024.

The Mains examination is scheduled for 20/09/2026. Candidates can check exam-city details and download the admit card through the official UPSSSC links below.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 12/02/2024
  • Last Date for Registration: 03/03/2024
  • Correction Last Date: 11/03/2024
  • Eligibility Result: 28/07/2026
  • Exam City Available: 11/09/2026
  • Exam Date: 20/09/2026
  • Admit Card: Before exam

Application Fee

All listed categories: ₹25. Pay through the prescribed SBI I Collect or e-challan mode.

Vacancy Details

  • Post: Pharmaceutical Ayurvedic
  • Total Posts: 1002
  • Category distribution: General 448, EWS 100, OBC 126, SC 291, ST 37

Eligibility

  • UPSSSC PET 2023 score card
  • Intermediate with Biology or Mathematics
  • Diploma in Pharmaceutical Ayurvedic
  • Registration with the relevant council

Candidates should carry the admit card and a valid photo ID to the examination centre and follow all instructions printed on the admit card.
